name: Send Tweaks
description: Small fixes to what you send. Removes tracking from links (?si=, utm_source, fbclid and friends), rewrites links with your own rules (twitter.com to fxtwitter.com, ready-made rules from the Text Replace thread, or your own imports), lets replies start without pinging, and applies your own find-and-replace rules. With AI Core installed, it can also write a rule from a description. Text inside code blocks is never touched.
author: bleelblep
